text.en: Pet owners consistently praise Lucy for her gentle demeanour, prompt responses, and informative guidance on coat care. Handlers appreciate her approachable style and readiness to answer questions about breed-specific grooming. Reviewers emphasize that her calm manner immediately puts anxious owners at ease.

title.en: Gentle handling for cats and dogs

text.en: Clients highlight exceptional patience when handling nervous pets, including first-time cats, reactive dogs, and young puppies. Reviewers note that animals that typically dislike dryers or brushing remain relaxed throughout their groom. Handlers value knowing their pets are treated with steady care and affection.

Owners report impressive results for cat dematting, puppy facials, and intensive deshedding treatments for heavy-shedding breeds. Pets return home with shiny, fragrant, and manageable coats that look visibly refreshed. Several reviewers note a noticeable reduction in loose fur around the home following appointments.

q.en: Does Sunshine Paws offer cat grooming services?

a.en: Yes, reviewers describe successful grooming and dematting appointments for both young and older cats.

q.en: Can reactive or dryer-sensitive dogs be groomed safely?

a.en: Yes, clients report that Lucy uses gentle, patient methods to keep reactive or nervous dogs calm throughout.

q.en: Are specialized deshedding treatments available for heavy shedders?

a.en: Yes, handlers mention tailored deshedding treatments that substantially reduced household shedding.
